View on BscScan ·

This window holds no keys and broadcasts nothing itself. It runs the Purchase Operation Map: buy (fiat to MUSDV/USDC), EMpro transfer (Treasury → Trust), the money market branch when toggled on, then Terminal → Found fiat. Wallet connection and signing happen directly through ThirdWeb inside this Terminal — everything stays within MAP, with no redirect to a separate connect page. ThirdWeb opens the signature request in your wallet; the Engine (SLVR8) executes the approved Terminal leg and the hash it reports is recorded here as delivery to Found is directed — this window queries no node directly, so the swap itself is confirmed on BscScan or via EMpro's summary. The VERITAS panel in the Terminal Report is a read-only preview rendered from EMpro's summary of the local node — when EMpro is not running it shows the node as offline rather than a live value.
